messages.subject: Aerial line transect survey manual online
parts:
Aerial survey folks:

Rich Guenzel has kindly given me a copy of his manual "Estimating Pronghorn
Abundance Using Aerial Line Transect Surveys" in pdf format. The manual
provides a detailed description of survey design, field methods and analysis
and may be of interest to anyone contemplating aerial line transect surveys.
With his agreement, I have uploaded a copy to the following web site:
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.book/pronghorn.html

It is also linked from the Distance home page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/
and the distance sampling book page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.book/

Hope it's of use to some of you, and thanks to Rich for making it available.

- Len Thomas
